name: Solano County, CA
findings: Solano County has 1,259 nonprofit organizations. 494 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 387 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Solano County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 17 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Few health care organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 150 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
